source_summary: Vertical ink-wash Chinese landscape with monumental cliffs on the right, distant water and hills on the left, small waterside village and bridge, foreground rock terrace, bare trees, and pine/leafy tree clusters. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_craggy_mountain
motifs.description: Isolate the high rocky summit and sloping ridge at the upper right: stacked rounded boulders, pale cliff faces, dark ink contour accents, scrubby pine marks, and the descending ridge line to the right.
must_preserve: soft pale mist gaps between rock tiers

motifs.name: main_vertical_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central cliff wall below the upper ridge, including the sheer vertical face, left buttress, shadowed ledges, and broad pale rock planes; exclude foreground trees as much as possible.
must_preserve: dark ledge marks along cliff edges

motifs.name: distant_conical_hill
motifs.description: Isolate the small rounded distant hill on the left across the water, with horizontal ink bands, soft shoreline haze, and faint surrounding mist.
motifs.role: distant hill and misty water backdrop
must_preserve: soft blurred base fading into water
open mist edges around the hill

motifs.name: waterside_village_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the small village and reeds at the far shore beneath the cliff: low rooflines, tiny rectangular buildings, shoreline strokes, and clumps of grasses or willows.
must_preserve: reed and willow strokes behind roofs

motifs.name: low_plank_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the short low bridge or walkway near the lower left-center water, with plank deck, vertical supports, and surrounding horizontal water lines.
must_preserve: open water gaps around the bridge

motifs.name: foreground_bare_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground grove of leafless trees rising in front of the cliff, including clustered trunks, forked branches, exposed roots, and small dark ink nodes.
must_preserve: contrast between sharp ink branches and pale cliff wash behind

motifs.name: right_pine_and_leafy_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side tree group growing beside rocks: angular pine branches with needle clusters, drooping leafy foliage, thin trunks, and adjacent rounded boulders.

motifs.name: foreground_rock_terrace_and_stones
motifs.description: Isolate the lower foreground rocky terrace with layered ledges, large rounded blocks, scattered small stones in open ground, and pale wash shadows.
must_preserve: horizontal ground and water wash lines

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
